purpose: Run the official TDX Windows client (and TQ components if actually usable) on this Windows machine and record version-bound official behavior outputs. Bind (a) displayed/exported business fields of frozen GBBQ events to the same-snapshot gbbq binary records C1..C4, and (b) displayed industry classification of fixed securities to tdxhy.cfg/tdxhy2.cfg file fields, using only official client behavior as new authoritative evidence.
source_first: Only behavior outputs produced by the installed official client (GUI display, client export files, TQ returns if usable) count as new authoritative evidence. Community decoders, open-source implementations, prior notes and candidate hit rates are diagnostic only.

fixed_samples.sample_rule: Samples are fixed by this plan and by #159/#53; no reselection, addition or substitution after observing outputs. New samples would require a separate freeze plan before use.

capture_methods.M1_local_files: Hash + copy raw bytes of client-downloaded official data files at snapshot times: hq_cache gbbq/gbbq.map/tdxhy.cfg/tdxhy2.cfg(if present)/tdxzs*.cfg/base.dbf/base.map/infoharbor*/addedcode*, root incon.dat/base.dbf, and vipdoc .day members for the four securities once downloaded. gbbq records for the two key events extracted and stored as raw hex in raw/.
capture_methods.M2_kline_export: For each Phase-A security: open K-line, set adjustment mode to 不复权 then 前复权 via the client's own UI, and use the client data-export function to produce its native text/CSV output; store raw export bytes in raw/ with sha256. If the export function is unavailable, record the displayed values window (M3) instead and mark export NOT_AVAILABLE.
capture_methods.M3_display_capture: Screenshots of the client's own display: 权息资料/分红扩股 (per-event business fields), K-line displayed OHLC values, F10 company profile industry fields, quote-list 细分行业 column, 板块归属. Each screenshot hashed; any text transcribed from a screenshot is marked transcribed_from with the image sha256.
capture_methods.M4_tq: If a usable official TQ/TdxQuant/TdxAiData interface is actually present and callable in this environment, record component version/config and capture get_divid_factors / market-data returns for the same samples. If not usable: TQ captures = NOT_RUN with reason.
capture_methods.order_rule: All captures for a sample occur against the recorded snapshot; if client data files change mid-run the change is recorded (before/after sha256) and the affected comparisons are marked INPUT_DRIFT.

binding_rules.gbbq_event_binding: A business-field->C-slot binding counts only if the official display/export names a business field (e.g. 派息/送股/转增/配股/配股价) with a value AND unit that uniquely identifies which C1..C4 slot carries it at the same snapshot, including scale (per-share vs per-10-share) and decimals. Two displays that fit multiple slot mappings = ambiguous, listed as such.
binding_rules.rounding_distinction: Displayed 2-decimal prices are display values; intermediate computation rounding is only claimable if observed outputs discriminate it (e.g. QFQ export values that distinguish half-up-at-2dp from exact-binary-then-display). Non-discriminating precision = UNIDENTIFIED, not a pass.
binding_rules.qfq_chain: Client 前复权 export compared against chains computed from the same-snapshot .day + gbbq record under each #159 frozen candidate rule; a candidate is consistent only if zero unexplained mismatch on the frozen events and the sampled window. The comparison script is committed; results in result.json.
binding_rules.industry_binding: A tdxhy.cfg field<->code-space binding counts only if the client-displayed classification for a fixed sample uniquely matches (via the #164 anchored name/code tables) the value stored in that field position of that security's tdxhy.cfg record at the same snapshot. A-share scope stays UNANCHORED unless official behavior actually delimits it.

prohibited: no reverse tuning, sample swapping, or candidate additions after observing outputs
no modification of the #159 frozen validation set
no overwriting or silently mixing data generations; every artifact binds to its recorded snapshot sha256
no disassembly/patch/hook/license bypass of client binaries
no credentials, keys, cookies or tokens in the repository; only non-sensitive auditable digests/text
no production gate changes; no QFQ/catalog production code changes
no claims that client merely running/downloading proves semantics

outputs.raw: raw/ (non-sensitive original exports, record hex, screenshot png files + sha256 list)
outputs.determinism: comparison/replay script re-run on committed raw inputs; determinism.json
